questions.question: What were the Israelites told to put on the corners of their garments as a reminder?
What happened to the man who gathered wood on the Sabbath?
options: He was put to death by stoning
He was driven out of the camp
He was pardoned and sent home
He was fined a measure of silver
questions.answer: He was put to death by stoning

questions.question: The tassels were meant to remind Israel to obey all the LORD's commandments.
